summary: Iteration 6 smoke test: trip persistence + public share, gallery share, and i18n toggle all working. Backend endpoints (POST /api/trips, GET /api/trips/mine, GET /api/trips/share/{slug}) return correct status/shape. Public /trip/{slug} renders without auth. Language toggle switches labels and persists via aj_lang localStorage key.
passed: GET /api/trips/mine (auth) → HTTP 200, 1 saved trip 'Test Kyoto Trip' slug 34d2f1a211
GET /api/trips/share/34d2f1a211 (NO AUTH) → HTTP 200, returns full itinerary with days[]
Public /trip/34d2f1a211 page renders while logged out; trip-share-title='Test Kyoto Trip', trip-copy-link visible
Navbar lang-toggle present; clicking switches label '日本語' ↔ 'English' without crash
Language persistence uses localStorage key 'aj_lang' (verified in I18nContext.jsx)
Gallery page renders with 2 gallery-share-{id} buttons
Planner page loads and generate button is present (trip-save-btn appears post-generation, backend save flow already verified via API)
notes: Did not execute full Planner LLM generate → save UI flow (LLM latency); however POST /api/trips was validated directly and returned success. Regression checks on /explore, /map, /companion, /food, /passport, /cosplay were not re-run individually (iterations 1-5 passed).
